name: BATTLE ART VOXEL FORK
description: 2.5D environments and battle presentation for Gen 1, Crystal and FireRed on Gen1Recomp 0.2.73+. Native-art plants, modeled exteriors and furniture, open-front interior dioramas, first-person and rotating cameras, shared render distance, contextual boundary scenery, optional lighting and depth of field. FireRed includes reviewed exterior families, home/lab/Mart/Center interiors and native battles over 3D scenery; specialty interiors and full depth-positioned FireRed battlers remain in progress. See docs/FIRERED_SUPPORT.md and docs/INTERIOR_DIORAMAS.md.
